events.text: Goal! Paris Saint Germain 1, Slovan Bratislava 0. Ousmane Dembélé (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Kenan Bajric (Slovan Bratislava).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Sahmkou Camara replaces Kenan Bajric because of an injury.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 2, Slovan Bratislava 0. Ousmane Dembélé (Paris Saint Germain) header from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 3, Slovan Bratislava 0. Ferran Torres (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ousmane Dembélé with a cross.
First Half ends, Paris Saint Germain 3, Slovan Bratislava 0.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 4, Slovan Bratislava 0. Ferran Torres (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Maghnes Akliouche.
César Blackman (Slovan Bratislava) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Paris Saint Germain 5, Slovan Bratislava 0. Ferran Torres (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ousmane Dembélé with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 5, Slovan Bratislava 1. Suleiman Camara (Slovan Bratislava) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Tigran Barseghyan.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Nino Marcelli replaces Tigran Barseghyan.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Alen Mustafic replaces Rahim Ibrahim.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Lucas Hernández replaces Willian Pacho.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Mika Godts replaces Ousmane Dembélé.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Senny Mayulu replaces Achraf Hakimi.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Lucas Digne replaces Nuno Mendes.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Beraldo replaces Ferran Torres.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Alexej Maros replaces Andraz Sporar.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Artur Gajdos replaces Cristian Martínez.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 6, Slovan Bratislava 1. Fabián Ruiz (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
